symbol.desc: An engraved portrait of Voyager: its great parabolic dish, three radioisotope generators, golden record, scan platform and long open magnetometer boom.
The James Webb Space Telescope as a copperplate engraving: eighteen tessellated mirror segments, a secondary mirror on three struts, and a five-layer folded sunshield.
A foreshortened barred spiral galaxy, engraved as a dense granular star field with two major arms and diffuse secondary arms.
A black-hole shadow framed by a gravitationally lensed accretion disk. Concentric engraved streams bend above and below the central darkness.

An engraved red supergiant with irregular granular convection, dark mottled photospheric patches and a densely stippled limb. A tiny point labelled Sol is a schematic comparison, not a numerical size chart.

Saturn drawn as an oblique astronomical engraving, with cloud belts, stippled limb shading and a finely divided ring system. The planet occludes the rear rings and the foreground rings occlude its lower hemisphere.
